# README-SETUP

## 1. Asset plan (all generated by `scripts/optional-generation-scripts/build_assets.py`)

| Asset | File(s) | Size | Format / animation |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hero (city, laptop, title, boot log) | `assets/hero/hero.svg` | 1200×600 | SVG; CSS twinkle, scanline, sequential boot lines |
| Identity panel (avatar-frame substitute) | `assets/hero/identity-panel.svg` | 900×400 | SVG; pulsing bullets |
| Terminal | `assets/animations/terminal.svg` | 900×560 | SVG; line-by-line reveal, blinking cursor |
| AI core | `assets/animations/ai-core.svg` | 900×560 | SVG; flowing dashed links, pulsing core |
| Experience log | `assets/animations/experience.svg` | 900×760 | SVG; pulsing nodes |
| Status / Now playing | `assets/animations/status.svg`, `now-playing.svg` | 440×330 | SVG; progress bar via SMIL (visual only, no audio) |
| Project cards (7 resume projects + 1 public repo) | `assets/projects/*.svg` | 600×270 | SVG; scan sweep |
| Achievement cards | `assets/achievements/*.svg` | 440×220 | SVG |
| Tech constellation | `assets/tech/*.svg` | 900×var | SVG chips with glow |
| Section headers | `assets/headers/*.svg` | 1000×90 | SVG; moving dashed rule |
| Contribution frame, footer | `assets/backgrounds/*.svg` | 900×80 / 1200×340 | SVG |
| Social buttons | `assets/social/*.svg` | 200×64 | SVG |

Total is about 200 KB, with no GIFs. Everything honours `prefers-reduced-motion`.

## 2. Optional upgrade prompts (for AI image/video tools)

These replace or augment the SVGs if you want painted artwork. Keep each under ~300 KB (WebP/PNG) and swap it into the matching `<img>`.

- **Hero background** (`hero-bg.webp`, 1600×800): "Cinematic cyberpunk city at night seen from a high window, a developer silhouette from behind at a desk with a glowing laptop, neon cyan, violet and magenta, deep navy #05070D, volumetric haze, rain on glass, wide 2:1, no text, no logos."
- **Avatar frame** (`avatar-frame.png`, 512×512, transparent): "Hexagonal holographic frame, thin electric-cyan outline, corner brackets, faint scanlines, empty transparent center."
- **Terminal animation** (`terminal.gif`, 900×560, ≤500 KB, 12 fps): screen-record the `whoami` / `current_focus` / `build --future` text in a dark terminal, 8–10 s loop, then optimize with gifsicle `-O3 --lossy=80`. The SVG already does this, so only use the GIF if you want real typing.
- **Neural network visual** (`ai-core.webp`, 1200×800): "Glowing central orb connected by luminous fibre-optic lines to four nodes labelled Computer Vision, LLMs, Generative AI, Agentic AI, dark background, cyan/violet/magenta, abstract, no photo."
- **Project thumbnails** (`<slug>.webp`, 600×270): per project, a dark holographic UI screenshot-style render (e.g. face-mesh wireframe for Deepfake, road with bounding boxes for Pothole, waveform + chat bubbles for Voice Agent).
- **Achievement cards**: "Dark glass trophy plaque, neon edge in amber/cyan/green/magenta, no text."
- **Footer background** (`footer.webp`, 1600×400): "Distant neon city skyline at dusk, magenta horizon glow, minimal, wide."
- **Technology icons**: use official SVGs from simpleicons.org / devicon (check each license); the current chips are text-only to avoid logo-trademark issues.

## 3. Setup

1. On GitHub create a **public** repo named exactly `Sarveshrock` (it already exists, so reuse it).
2. Copy `README.md` and the whole `assets/` folder into the repo root. Optionally copy `scripts/` too.
3. Back up the old README first (it is currently the Full Stack template).
4. Commit and push to `main`. The profile updates immediately. Relative image paths (`assets/...`) work on github.com.
5. LinkedIn is linked (URL supplied by you). Portfolio is linked (URL supplied by you; returned HTTP 200, title "Sarvesh Shimpi's portfolio").
6. Suggested GitHub bio (set at github.com/settings/profile; I cannot edit it): "AI/ML Engineer at Infosys. Computer Vision, Generative AI, LLMs."

To regenerate or edit assets: `python scripts/optional-generation-scripts/build_assets.py`, then commit.

## 4. Dynamic elements

| Element | Source | Updates |
|---|---|---|
| Repos / Followers / Following badges | shields.io reading the GitHub API | live (cached about 1 hour) |
| Stats card, Top languages | github-readme-stats.vercel.app | live (cached about 4 h; the public instance sometimes rate-limits and shows an error, see below) |
| Streak | streak-stats.demolab.com | live |
| Trophies | github-profile-trophy.vercel.app | live |
| Contribution matrix | github-readme-activity-graph.vercel.app | live, last 31 days |

If a public Vercel instance is down or rate-limited, self-host it (free): fork `anuraghazra/github-readme-stats` to Vercel with a `PAT_1` token, then replace the hostname in the README. Everything else in the page is static.

Optional full-year contribution snake: add `.github/workflows/snake.yml` using `Platane/snk` (output to an `output` branch), then add `<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sarveshrock/Sarveshrock/output/github-contribution-grid-snake-dark.svg">` under the matrix.

## 5. Maintenance (every few months)

- New role, project or achievement: edit the data blocks (`PROJECTS`, `ACH`, `TECH`, and `experience()`) in `build_assets.py`, re-run, commit.
- When a resume project goes public: move it into the public-repositories block, wrap the card in `<a href="https://github.com/Sarveshrock/<repo>">`.
- Update the footer year in `footer()`.
- Check that the third-party stats images still load.
- Clean up repos visible to recruiters (see notes below).

## 6. Mobile

- Everything uses `width="100%"` or a fixed `width` capped at 720 px, so GitHub scales it down and no horizontal scrolling occurs.
- Projects, achievements and status panels are stacked in a single column on purpose. Two-column tables shrink SVG text to about 7 px on phones.
- Large text in the hero (about 100 px in a 1200 px viewBox) stays readable. The boot-log text inside the hero is small on phones, and its content is repeated as real text in the terminal section.
- Every image has descriptive alt text, so screen readers and text-only views still get the content.

## 7. Fact provenance (Golden rule: visual creativity unlimited, factual creativity zero)

- Resume-sourced: roles, dates, education, skills, the 7 projects, achievements. Project cards say "SOURCE: RESUME · NO PUBLIC REPO" and carry no links.
- GitHub-sourced: UnmaskAI (description "SEED HACKATHON Submission", language Python, verified to exist). Repo count, followers and following are live badges, never typed in.
- User-supplied self-descriptions (identity panel, terminal, "currently building" list, tagline) come from your own brief, not from either source. Review them if you want a strictly evidence-only page.
- Not shown: phone number, any repo not verified, AURA, AI-Contract, BoxOffice, FileFinder, Travel-Planner-AI, DeepSafe, Jarber, HarvestHero, Portfolio link.
- Repo hygiene is yours to handle: NASA, Max-num and Intern have unprofessional descriptions.
